title: Jeremy Corbell and the missing page of the Shellenberger-released government document

tellings.quote: Jeremy Corbel went on that whole tangent about the the missing page and the fact that he >> his name was taken off of the whole thing and it just really rubbed me the wrong way.

plain: A government document about unexplained aerial sightings, released in 2024 by the journalist Michael Shellenberger, was said to be missing a page, and the UFO filmmaker Jeremy Corbell spoke out about it at length, including that a name had been taken off it. The musician Flying Lotus, a hip hop artist who follows the subject, recalls this, naming the journalist George Knapp and Matthew Brown alongside Corbell. He says the whole affair rubbed him the wrong way, as if something had been cut from the public record.
